utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Good morning to everybody. Mr. Registrar, may you call for appearances.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Yes. Thank you, Mr. -- Thank you, Your Honour --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Just call the case. I'm sorry. I'm sorry. It's too early in the morning.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Case Number IT-98-34-A --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Just call the case --

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: -- the Prosecutor versus Mladen Naletilic and Vinko Martinovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you. Now may I call for the appearances of the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. KREMER
utterances.text: Yes, Peter Kremer and Marie-Ursula Kind appearing as counsel for the Prosecution. Our case manager, Lourdes Galicia, is with us.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you. Now may we have the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. MEEK
utterances.text: May it please Your Honour, C.Y. Meek, Baxter Springs, Kansas, for Mladen Naletilic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. PAR
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honour. Zelimir Par, Defence counsel for Mr. Martinovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. Now, may I ask the appellants if they can hear the proceedings in a language they understand. Is there any problem with the translation? THE APPELLANT MARTINOVIC: [Interpretation] Yes. Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. I feel that I don't have to recall you the requirements to hold this Status Conference because I hope this will be the last Status Conference in this case. I note that the appellants last appeared before the Appeals Chamber on 17/18 October 2005 for the appeals hearing. Now, the first thing I would like to ask the appellants if there is any concern relating to the appeal, to detention conditions. Is there any problem of this kind? THE APPELLANT NALETILIC: [Interpretation] No, Your Honour. THE APPELLANT MARTINOVIC: [Interpretation] No, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. If there is no concern of this kind, as to the status of the case I don't have much to say. I mean, the appeal was heard, as I said earlier, in October, last October, and the Appeals Chamber is in the process of drafting the appeals judgement that will be issued in due course in not a too long time now. It will be in a relatively short delay, but of course I cannot say anything about the judgement now. As for myself, I do not have anything more to say. I would ask the parties if there is any matter they wish -- they wish to raise at this juncture. Prosecution?

utterances.speaker: MR. KREMER
utterances.text: No, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you. Defence, may I ask if there is anything you want to raise at this point?

utterances.speaker: MR. MEEK
utterances.text: [Microphone not activated]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: There is a problem. It's gone off. Now we have a technical problem.

utterances.speaker: MR. MEEK
utterances.text: It's on. It's working. Your Honour, I would just like to say that the request had been made of the Defence counsel and the accused to possibly waive this hearing a week or two ago, and I'd just like to say that had we been in a position to speak with our -- at least personally myself -- if I have been in a position to speak with my client personally, face-to-face, this Status Conference possibly likely would have been waived; however, we've been denied the right to consult with our clients on a monthly basis as we always have since this case has started, since I've been involved for four years, and I just wanted to let the Court know that that is the reason we could not waive that without speaking to our client -- my client, at least.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: Thank you, but there is no problem. It was not a formal request it was just a just -- I just asked the parties if they wish to have the Status Conference or not. I mean, simply that. Mr. Par?

utterances.speaker: MR. PAR
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, the Defence for Mr. Martinovic has no questions in relation to this Status Conference.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE POCAR
utterances.text: I thank you very much. Well, if this is the case, I believe we can adjourn the proceedings now. The Status Conference is therefore adjourned.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the Status Conference adjourned at
